keys.custody: generated inside the Cloudflare Worker; the private key exists only as a non-extractable Cloudflare secret_key binding

custody_boundary: Private keys must live only in Cloudflare Workers Secrets when activated. No private signing key is embedded in Worker source, public discovery files, reports, or client payloads.
verification_note: Configured signatures can be verified against this registry. V1 authenticates only key ID and immutable hash, not independent signing time, human attestation, or execution permission.

key_ceremony.evidence_basis: key_generated_inside_cloudflare_worker_birth_record_signed_by_the_key; attendance is evidenced by the signed paper record and sworn declarations, not by this registry

birth_record.statement: Generated inside the Cloudflare Worker named above and stored only as a non-extractable secret_key binding. No person, device or AI agent received the private key. This record proves possession of the key and its ceremony metadata, not who attended: the signed paper record and sworn declarations do that.

key_ceremony.birth_record_signature_payload: UTF-8 bytes of "MVR-RECEIPT-KEY-BIRTH-V1\n" + canonical JSON of birth_record (keys sorted, no spaces), signed with this key
key_ceremony.private_key_custody: Generated inside the Worker and stored only as a non-extractable Cloudflare secret_key binding: code can ask Cloudflare to sign with it but cannot read it back. Never given to a person, device or AI agent.
key_ceremony.public_key_source: Ceremony record written by the Worker at generation
key_ceremony.rotation_policy: dual-key rotation target every 12 months or immediately after suspected compromise
